texts.value: Forms a receptor-activated non-selective calcium permeant cation channel (By similarity). Acts as a cell-cell contact-dependent endothelial calcium entry channel (By similarity). Forms a homomeric ion channel or a heteromeric ion channel with TRPC1; the heteromeric ion channel has reduced calcium permeability compared to the homomeric channel (By similarity). Also permeable to monovalent ions including sodium, lithium and cesium ions (By similarity)

Forms a non-selective a receptor-activated calcium permeant cation channel. Probably is operated by a phosphatidylinositol second messenger system activated by receptor tyrosine kinases or G protein-coupled receptors

May be operated by a phosphatidylinositol second messenger system activated by receptor tyrosine kinases or G protein coupled receptors (PubMed:11713258). May be activated by intracellular calcium store depletion (By similarity)

Homotetramer (PubMed:12857742). Heterotetramer with TRPC1 and/or TRPC5 (PubMed:12857742). Forms a heteromeric ion channel with TRPC1, with a 1:3 TRPC1:TRPC4 stoichiometry (By similarity). Interacts with TRPC4AP (By similarity). Isoform alpha but not isoform beta interacts with ITPR1, ITPR2 and ITPR3 (By similarity). Interacts with NHERF1 (By similarity). Interacts with MX1 and RNF24 (By similarity). Interacts (via CIRB domain) with SESTD1 (via the spectrin 1 repeat) and SPTBN5 (via C-terminus) (By similarity). Interacts with CDH5 and CTNNB1 (By similarity). Interacts (via protein 4.1-binding domain) with EPB41L2 (By similarity). Interacts with PLSCR1 (By similarity)
Belongs to the transient receptor (TC 1.A.4) family. STrpC subfamily. TRPC4 sub-subfamily
